en.html:
ウィロー"Clive. ...Fortune favor you in battle."
Cannon"Instead of good fortune for me, could you pray for Her Majesty’s luck to run out? I fancy that would do us rather more good."
ウィロー"I shall. With the two hundred million of our compatriots in our great homelandOur America."
